description: A gate processor that turns one clock into four related gate streams, by division, multiplication or a pattern

params.text: Picks the program the four outputs follow, from a simple divider through fixed multiplication and division sets to pattern, drum, random and sequence programs
Sets which configuration of the program is running, marked 0 to 5
Sets that output to the stage the module is on now
Picks which of the three sets of numbers in the chosen program is used
Picks how the outputs are shaped: Norm, Skip or Inverted
Picks what the outputs send: a Gate, a Binary pattern or a Trigger

inputs.text: The clock the whole module counts
A gate here sends every output back to the start of its count

outputs.text: The gate stream for that output, at the division printed beside it for a simple program
